Introduction

Lee Hyeop is a South Korean singer under Woollim Entertainment. He debuted on October 28, 2020, as the main vocalist of the boy group DRIPPIN. He was first known for appearing and competing in the hit boy group survival program "Produce X 101".

In 2025 he was revealed as a contestant on the survival show Boys II Planet.
